states.OBSERVED_COMPLETE: required fixed window is observed completely or a first-passage event is observed before censoring
states.RIGHT_CENSORED: event-time outcome is not observed before a valid censor boundary
states.SESSION_TERMINATED: fixed-horizon path outcome requests time beyond the admitted session boundary
states.SOURCE_PATH_INCOMPLETE: an unseen interval prevents authoritative evaluation
states.NOT_EVALUABLE: anchor or required geometry is invalid or unavailable
